sections.means: Kerala has the most coconut area of any state but the lowest yield among the big four producing states.
sections.todo: Treat the gap between the best and worst major state as the expansion target, not new acreage.

sections.h2: The Coconut Development Board raised its area-expansion grant eightfold

chart.title: Area-expansion grant rose from ₹6,500 to ₹56,000 per hectare
chart.sub: National area-expansion grant, rupees per hectare.

sections.means: The Board moved money, not only advice, which signals that the productivity problem needs funding.
sections.todo: Watch whether the new rate moves replanting, since ageing palms may remain the binding constraint.
